name: Maya (technical narrator)
sounds_like: Mid female at 198 Hz, dark and warm for the pitch (centroid 1347 Hz), moving in a controlled 7.3-semitone range. Even 5.6 onsets per second with breaths up to 0.92s and only 9% silence, so it runs steadily without sounding rushed. Clean, no rasp. 27.2s of technical lecture material on multimodal models - precise diction, terms landed deliberately.
casts_well_as: Technical narrator, documentary voiceover, explainer, briefing or lecture delivery, a warm machine or assistant voice.
avoid_for: High emotion, shouting, youth, or comedy. It is built for exposition, not for reaction.
note: The strongest female cloning reference here: 27.2s of clean single-speaker audio, inside the recommended 24-30s band. Byte-identical to voices_examples/vibevoice/en-Maya_woman.wav.
